title: My Twentieth Summer
transcription:
My Twentieth Summer

Chorus:
On my twentieth summer,
I wandered on my own,
to find a land that God had made,
and man had left alone.
I found a land of beauty,
I never would have known,
had not my twentieth summer
brought me here, to Cherry Cove.

I left the hurried city
and all my cares behind,
to wander 'cross the ocean,
to see what I might find.
I wandered over mountains,
through waters emerald green,
Oh, it would take a thousand days
to tell what I have seen.

Chorus

For it's here I can be happy,
and here I love to roam,
But my heart will still be yearning
for the girl I left back home.
So I'll be gone by Monday,
to make her mine alone,
and on my twenty-first summer
bring her here, to Cherry Cove

Chorus
